tools.name: GetRouterEvidence
tools.description: Read-only evidence for tuning a model router, from the agent runs of the router (all users' runs when the caller owns the router, else the caller's own): per subtask and served model, the routed steps, cost in micros, failed run share, thumbs-down count, config versions seen, and with sample a sample of real routed steps per subtask.

engineId.description: The model router engine id whose routed steps are summarized.

sample.description: 0 to 20: also return up to this many routed steps per subtask (step_sample: goal, previous subtask, current tool names and statuses, run status, cost). Use it to find step types.

tools.name: GetModelRouterConfig
tools.description: Returns the routing configuration (router.json contents) for a model router engine. Requires edit access to the engine.

engine.description: The id of the model router engine

tools.name: CreateSkill
tools.description: Creates a new skill (a SKILL-type Project) and writes its SKILL.md into the project's version/assets/public/ folder

skillContent.description: SKILL.md body, with or without a YAML frontmatter block. A frontmatter block will be synthesized from 'name' and 'description' if absent

name.description: Display name. Wins over the SKILL.md frontmatter's 'name' when supplied; frontmatter is the fallback only when this param is omitted entirely

description.description: Description. Wins over the SKILL.md frontmatter's 'description' when supplied; frontmatter is the fallback only when this param is omitted entirely

tools.name: ReadSkillFile
tools.description: Returns the contents of one file of a skill, for example SKILL.md. Use it to read a skill you wrote earlier before refining it.

filePath.description: Path inside the skill, for example SKILL.md.

tools.name: WriteRouterCandidate
tools.description: Clones the live model router into a new private candidate engine and writes the given routing configuration (without an improvement section) there. Returns candidateEngineId. The live router is not changed.

liveEngineId.description: The live model router engine id to base the candidate on.

map.description: The candidate's routing configuration matching the router.json schema.

tools.name: EvaluateRouterCandidate
tools.description: Replays a recorded task set in new rooms on the strongest model (the reference), on a candidate router engine and on the live router. A candidate or live run counts as good when it is at least as good as the reference result of the same task (the judge compares readable answers and output files side by side). Returns the paired differences against the live router (quality and cost with their noise), a plain-words decision, a failure_digest and an evaluationId. Spends model money: checks spend before judge calls; submitted replay runs can exceed the admission target, but an over-budget evaluation cannot promote.

jobCostCapMicros.description: Stop once the runs' cost reaches this many micros (millionths of a dollar).

judgeModelId.description: Model engine id that compares each run with the strongest model's result.

candidateEngineId.description: The candidate model router engine id the tasks run on.

taskSet.description: Id of the TRAIN or VAL replay set assigned to this learning attempt.

liveEngineId.description: The live router; the candidate is compared with it on the same tasks, which ApplyRouterCandidate requires.

tools.name: ApplyRouterCandidate
tools.description: Applies a candidate router's config to the live router when the stored evaluation (from EvaluateRouterCandidate, same user, the candidate's current config) passes the gate: within the allowed observed quality loss, and either cheaper beyond noise or better beyond noise without a cost increase beyond noise. Otherwise returns the reason and changes nothing.

evaluationId.description: The evaluationId returned by EvaluateRouterCandidate for that candidate.

liveEngineId.description: The live model router engine id to update.

candidateEngineId.description: The candidate router engine id (a clone of the live router that was edited and evaluated).
